items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Where I think we had, we had the best band. Because we had a battle with them one time and I know we won, everybody said we won.

ctx.x: He went to join Les Hite. Now, Les Hite was working at the Cotton Club. They had

the best job. And that's when I met Louis, was in '32. The first time I ever seen Louis and he was working at the Cotton Club. It was the big club. They made more money. And Fats Waller had played the Cotton Club with Les Hite. Les Hite was the home band.
